reviews.comment: She is a poor lecturer and the class structure is just all wrong. The whole grade is based on a group project and there are also tests that you will have every few weeks that she doesn't teach on. She posted the study guides and basically told us to focus on the project but also read through 6, 12 page study guides to learn the content.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed her class. The class was not hard as long as you don't use AI and attend her class. The only people that are complaining did not show up and tried to get through the class using prompts.

She keeps her lectures engaging and interesting, but she allows only 2 unexcused absences or else she drops a letter grade. I really enjoyed her lectures, she made them fun and interactive, but she is a pretty hard grader.

People will say she's a tough grader-- the truth is, she believes that no one can get a 100 despite being very vague in her assignment instructions. Going to class is a slog because she will just cover what you already learned in the 100 questions McGraw Hill gave you. She accused multiple people of using AI with no basis. Would not take again.

I loved Dr. Kim! She is funny and engaging in her lectures and cares about her students. She is a tougher grader, and the partner and group projects are weighted the most, so make sure you follow the guidelines for those, otherwise the class was pretty chill. 315 ended up being my favorite class of the semester! Would recommend 100%!
she is funny. and really care about students. I love she prepares a lot of examples from movies and shows take her!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Really good professor. I enjoyed her class. Just make sure you always show up. She is very strict with attendance. Besides thar, it was great😊

Its a fine class but the whole thing felt like burning time. Its easy to get an A if you just do the work, its not that deep. Attendance was mandatory and if you got 3 absences you lose a letter grade which is kind of ridiculous. She also talked to us like we were toddlers which felt kind of bad.
She's funny and there are two main group project throughout the semester and two exams.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Nah don't take her. She isn't a bad prof, but if you just need a comm credit, don't take her class. You have major assignments, all of which are group assignments and who you are grouped with can determine the final grade you receive. Gives very broad requirements for papers and grades extremely harshly. Don't expect to know what she expects.

Professor Kim is an excellent instructor. She explains concepts clearly, makes the class engaging, and always encourages participation. Her feedback is thoughtful and detailed, which really helps me improve. She genuinely cares about her students' success and creates a supportive learning environment. I highly recommend taking her class!
Dr. Kim is energetic, kind, and a great teacher. She gives thoughtful feedback and I enjoyed learning from her class. I'd definitely take her class again.

I just took Dr. Kim's class and she was very kind. She accommodated me after hours to ask questions I had on papers. She is just very strict with attendance and the use of AI. Even if your grammar or writing is not the best she appreciates you trying and using your own words and voice. Thank you Dr. Kim!!!

I have taken this professor twice and overall her expectations on papers and projects are very unclear. Did not learn anything and found lectures to be repetitive. I do not recommend. Attendance is mandatory and she will drop you by a letter grade for more than 3 absences.

Eunhui gave me a 0 on an essay worth 10%, accusing me of using AI with no proof; literally said "I guess" in submission comment. I wrote it myself, yet she refused to have a professional conversation/give any real evidence. Grades by vibes, not rubrics, and you have to decode "feedback." Take her if you enjoy guessing games and baseless accusations

Most grades came from group assignments, minor and major. If your randomly assigned group sucks, good luck. She is not very clear when answering questions about these assignments and takes off points for reasons I still don't understand. Not an incredibly hard class but definitely annoying. She's nice though. Takes daily attendance with 3 excused.

Liked lectures but the assignments & grading were annoying. You get assigned a partner to work & meet with a few times over the semester. I got assigned a partner who was completely unhelpful & very difficult. It made this class a nightmare so it's the luck of the draw I guess. She's a tough grader and the expectations and feedback are unclear.

Enjoyed her class! Simple lectures and lists expectations for each speech. Willing to help & give advice. If you do more than the minimum requirements for content you'll do fine (stay within time frame though). Will provide more direct feedback if asked. Show up to class bc you'll be docked if you have more than a set amount of unexcused absences.

Dr. Kim is good. She contradicts herself sometimes so you must ask for detailed feedback. The class is based on 3 reports with a partner, 1 midterm and final, 1 group project, 12 weekly discussions, and 1 big report at the end of the semester. Attendance is taken with iClicker, she deducts 10 points if you have more than 3 unexcused absences.

Dr. Kim is absolutely the BEST!! She doesn't give out a lot of homework, and her lectures are very light and straight forward! The only thing I would really focus on are requirements for the speech and the monthly quizzes! She has such a caring personality, and she is really fun and easy to talk to! One of the best professor's I've ever had! :D

Dr Kim was a really good professor and always gave good constructive feedback whenever asked. Her lectures can be repetitive at times but she's very friendly and engaging with the class so it's not very noticeable. She doesn't always respond to emails, but if it's about attendance or sick notes she'll say that she saw it when you ask her.

One of the most understanding professors. I was on the verge on an A and she allowed me to redo an assignment in order to bump it up. She is caring about her students, and understands that we have a bunch of other courses. I would take her again for another course if possible. Very group project heavy, but if you stay ahead, I promise it's not bad

Dr Kim was a kind and caring professor! This was her first time teaching this large lecture-style class, so she had a few setbacks. But overall, as she continues to teach this class, I think students will better understand it.

I just took her for 308 (not an option on here) and she seemed new to it. Takes attendance every class and is group project based. I feel that the assignments are graded pretty tough but not terribly. She's really sweet and has a good sense of humor, so I think her understanding of the course will get better with time.

Dr. Kim is really passionate about what she teaches! She is great at using examples to help a theory make sense through pop culture. Definitely a project heavy class, but I thought they were pretty enjoyable. Her projects and tests are pretty well balanced so you don't really feel like your grade relies on one thing.

You must attend class or it will affect your grade severely. The content of the class is easy, her lectures are pretty straight forward. The exams are not difficult if you go over the material. You must put effort into your papers and group project as the quality of the work reflects the grading. Would not take again due to too strict attendance.
Freaking love this woman. Attendance is required so if you skip class she is not for you. But she gives great feedback and is so nice and funny.
Randomly-assigned groups and her atrocious attendance policy make this class far more  difficult than the subject matter or assignments would entail.

Prof. Kim is very funny and loved her lectures. HW is weekly packback and projects. We barely had tests, but they were pretty easy. She posts her powerpoints also. Attendance is mandatory, but she gives you 3 unexcused absences.

makes lots of jokes and makes lectures enjoyable with trendy topics that engage students. A tough grader, but she's still generous, she just never gives a 100% on a speech cause she always believes there is room to improve. She fosters a great classroom to make giving a speech for those with speech anxiety comfortable. I would take her again.

She's funny and has lectures that can be understood. The majority of your grade will consist of essays, and she does grade more strictly on those, and there are some parts of each paper that are made unclear.

A ton of work! With tough grading for it to all be group work and other peoples work reflects your grade. A lot of meeting up with people and doing group work just a lot of work for tough grades that are determined by others

Dr. Kim was one of the first professors I had in college and she was truly amazing. She is a hard grader because she wants you to be better, but it is easy to improve in her class as she gives detailed feedback on every grade. She is always available to contact and wants to help each student.

super nice prof. i suck at public speaking but she gets that and knows ppl just need the comm/engl credit so not a super tough grader. allows notes for speeches. 3 online opennote quizzes + 7 completion assignments + 4 speeches. 10pt bonus for 100% attendance, can miss 3 classes w no penalty,10pt extra credit hw, has extra credit from speeches too

Overall the class was easy. I had a major issue with the attendance process. Each person gets an individual QR code to scan. I scanned the code every day and it ended up counting me absent in the system for 5 days. She only fixed it if you showed proof like Life 360 record. Every other person I talked to had absences when present. GET LIFE 360

Don't listen to the negative reviews she was one of the best teachers I've had. Very easy to communicate, her grading criteria is clear, and the assignments were easy! Don't be afraid of public speaking as she helps you along the way and is very understanding! Just show up to class and put in the work.

Professor Kim is extremely well versed in her field and easy to talk to.  There were two main quizzes- midterm and final as well as chapter quizzes that had to be submitted by the end of the semester and two group projects worth a whole chunk of your grade. Overall, easy class!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Accessible outside class
